fact: The flumph speaks directly into the minds of those it encounters.
source_quote: The small floating creature spoke directly into their minds
subject: flumph

fact: The flumph claims to be a being that feeds on the background psionic energy radiated by evil creatures.
source_quote: It introduced itself as a being that fed on the background psionic energy radiated by evil creatures.
subject: flumph

fact: The flumph unleashes a torrent of vivid, distressing psychic visions upon the party.
source_quote: the flumph unleashed a torrent of vivid, distressing psychic visions upon them.
subject: flumph psychic assault

fact: The party sees a vision of a shrine to Demogorgon.
source_quote: They saw a shrine to Demogorgon,
subject: vision of shrine

fact: The party sees a vision of a broken magical shard being worked upon near a dark obelisk.
source_quote: a broken magical shard being worked upon near a dark obelisk,
subject: magical shard

fact: The party sees a vision of a stolen red dragon egg being subjected to cruel experiments.
source_quote: and a stolen red dragon egg being subjected to cruel experiments.
subject: red dragon egg

fact: The flumph announces that it feels much better after unburdening itself on the party.
source_quote: the flumph announced cheerfully that it felt much better, having unburdened itself entirely at the party's expense.
subject: flumph relief

fact: Thorin names the flumph's behavior 'trauma dumping'.
source_quote: Thorin promptly named the habit: it had "trauma dumped" on them.
subject: naming of habit

fact: A cave opens off to the south from a bend in the passage.
source_quote: A cave opens off to the south
subject: natural cave

fact: Zalthir stealthily scouts ahead with a Stealth roll of 26.
source_quote: Zalthir stealthily scouts ahead with a Stealth roll of 26
subject: Zalthir scouting

fact: Thorin notes that his own stealth abilities are essentially non-existent.
source_quote: Thorin notes that his own stealth abilities "are essentially non-existent."
subject: Thorin

fact: Three myconid adults in the cave stand five feet tall.
source_quote: Three myconid adults stand five feet tall
subject: myconid adults

fact: The myconid sprouts in the cave are half the height of the adults.
source_quote: the sprouts are half that height.
subject: myconid sprouts

fact: One small sprout stands apart from the rest with movement that is not nearly as frantic.
source_quote: One small sprout stands apart from the rest, its movement not nearly as frantic.
subject: small sprout

fact: The party's myconid friend taught them that myconids do not dance and instead farm and sit around in circles.
source_quote: The party recalls what their myconid friend taught them: "myconids don't dance." They farm and sit around in circles.
subject: myconid friend

fact: Two larger ape-like creatures in the cave are identified as quaggoth spore servants covered in mushroom growths and yellow mold.
source_quote: The scouts identify two larger ape-like creatures as quaggoth spore servants covered in mushroom growths and yellow mold.
subject: quaggoth spore servants

fact: The party decides to avoid the fungal creatures for now and resume following the trail east.
source_quote: The party decides to avoid the fungal creatures for now and flags them to raise with their contacts later. They then resume following the trail east.
subject: party decision

fact: Daz worries that the myconids could turn the party into spore servants.
source_quote: Daz worries they could turn the party into spore servants
subject: Daz

fact: Daz is reminded that myconids typically have to kill you first to create spore servants.
source_quote: and is reminded that "typically, they have to kill you first."
subject: spore servant reminder
